title: The Nvidia Spy Scandal Was Hiding in Plain Sight
gist: David Ignatius (syndicated from the Washington Post) argues Jensen Huang appears to be the most prominent American yet caught in a Ministry of State Security honey trap via Alice Huang of Megaspeed, an operation intelligence veterans see as double-barreled (Nvidia chip procurement plus influence over Trump tech policy), and asks why U.S. warnings — including to Trump and via Marco Rubio — stalled.
